audits.purpose: Revalidate older Part84-Part90 candidate-only rows against structured target-year 2024 tables after prior dual-year column corrections exposed search/index weaknesses.
audits.result: Twenty-four candidate rows across nine facilities revalidated with zero retractions, zero additions and zero duplicate changes.
audits.tyseley_integrity: Fresh structured 2024 table independently confirms Part100 Tyseley HCl 17,394 kg and ammonia 5,491 kg as target-year rows, removing concern raised by a stale shorter search excerpt.
audits.bridgwater_integrity: Bridgwater renewable-source CO2 5,505,000 kg is explicitly present in the structured 2024 PI table and remains valid despite the facility's commissioning/maintenance context.
audits.duplicate_policy: Authoritative prior report blobs remain the uniqueness authority; search indexing is not treated as proof of absence.
audits.direct_raw_policy: These are secondary reproductions explicitly attributed to EA PI 2024; no direct raw facility row is consumed and confidence remains capped at 98.
audits.zero_policy: Absent, particulate, trace-metal and later-year rows remain no-data and are never inferred as zero.
